s1.syndrome_frame: Progressive muscle weakness with respiratory and swallowing difficulties
salient_findings: Progressive muscle weakness starting in lower limbs then upper limbs
Muscle power: Grade 3- in proximal upper limbs and Grade 2 in lower limbs
key_facts: Born at 28 weeks by C-section for fetal distress
Reduced fetal movements and polyhydramnios during antenatal period
Very low birth weight (0.915 kg)
Delayed motor development in early childhood
Wheelchair-bound by age 20
High-arched palate and elongated face with dolichocephaly
Mildly elevated plasma creatine kinase (379 U/L)
Normal deep tendon reflexes and sensory examination
Giant motor unit potential and neuropathic changes in proximal and distal muscles on EMG
Fatty infiltration, mild fiber size variation, and internalized nuclei on muscle biopsy

shortlist.label: Limb-girdle muscular dystrophy
shortlist.why_kept: Progressive muscle weakness with proximal muscle involvement

shortlist.label: Bethlem myopathy
shortlist.why_kept: Contractures and progressive muscle weakness with distinctive facial features

shortlist.label: Rigid spine muscular dystrophy
shortlist.why_kept: Progressive muscle weakness with spinal rigidity and contractures

shortlist.label: Ullrich congenital muscular dystrophy
shortlist.why_kept: Congenital onset with progressive muscle weakness and distinctive contractures

shortlist.label: LAMA2-related muscular dystrophy
shortlist.why_kept: Congenital onset with progressive muscle weakness and white matter changes on brain MRI

raw.rationale: The patient's history of reduced fetal movements, polyhydramnios, very low birth weight, delayed motor development, and progressive muscle weakness are consistent with LAMA2-related muscular dystrophy. The presence of high-arched palate, elongated face with dolichocephaly, and muscle biopsy findings of fatty infiltration, mild fiber size variation, and internalized nuclei also support this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Limb-girdle muscular dystrophy
rejected.why: Limb-girdle muscular dystrophy typically presents later in life and does not typically have the same level of congenital and infantile features as seen in this patient

rejected.label: Bethlem myopathy
rejected.why: Bethlem myopathy is characterized by contractures and joint deformities, which are not mentioned in the patient's history

rejected.label: Rigid spine muscular dystrophy
rejected.why: Rigid spine muscular dystrophy is characterized by a rigid spine and limited joint mobility, which are not prominent features in this patient's presentation

rejected.label: Ullrich congenital muscular dystrophy
rejected.why: Ullrich congenital muscular dystrophy is characterized by severe muscle weakness and contractures at birth, which is not consistent with this patient's history of delayed motor development and progressive weakness
